t: 8 Reasons To Buy Artisanal and Handmade Products – Verve Culture
s: July 19, 2022 - Many artisanal creators are so good at their craft that you can’t tell that each item is completely unique—but they are. Every handmade product is entirely original, and their tiny imperfections make these items special. You can proudly display your glassware or woodwork in your home, knowing that no one else in the world has that product, which can’t be said for many things these days. Buying from artisans helps more than just the artisan—it also supports the economy surrounding that craftsperson.
